svg.aria-label: What I build: intelligent AI-powered apps, cross-platform Flutter apps, modern UI design trends at 120 FPS, cloud and offline database systems, and feature-first clean architecture

g.text: Mobile apps that feel native, respond instantly, and scale cleanly.
Modern UI design trends, fluid motion,
combined with reactive Drift ORM and SQLite local databases
for real-time cloud sync and resilient offline persistence.
Decoupled presentation, domain and data layers.
Predictable state management with BLoC / Cubit and Provider
that scales smoothly across complex codebases.
Smooth at 120 FPS • Cloud & Local DB Sync • Clean, testable architecture • Multi-Modal AI & Agents • One codebase, every screen •
